terminals.name: phone-api
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; exec env VESPER_PHONE_MODEL=gemma3:1b python3 -m companion.phone_api

terminals.name: gradio
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; exec env OPENAI_API_KEY=ollama OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 GRADIO_SERVER_NAME=0.0.0.0 python3 app.py
